Sergei Antonov  
Email: sergei.antonov@cybershieldtech.com | Phone: +972-54-123-4567 | Location: Tel Aviv, Israel  

Professional Experience  
From 2021 to 2023, I transitioned from a junior web developer to a frontend engineer at CyberShield Technologies, a mid-sized cybersecurity firm specializing in threat detection and incident response. At SecureNet Solutions in 2021, I focused on building responsive dashboards for threat detection tools, leveraging React and TypeScript to create modular, maintainable interfaces. This role required close collaboration with backend teams to ensure seamless integration of real-time data feeds, which laid the foundation for my work in optimizing frontend performance for security monitoring platforms at CyberShield. In 2022, I led efforts to reduce load times by 30% through lazy loading and code-splitting strategies, directly contributing to the platform’s scalability under high-traffic scenarios. By 2023, my responsibilities expanded to include accessibility compliance, where I designed UI components adhering to WCAG 2.1 standards, ensuring equitable access for users with disabilities while maintaining the platform’s stringent security protocols.  

Projects  
At CyberShield, I spearheaded the redesign of the threat detection dashboard, integrating TypeScript to refactor legacy JavaScript code and eliminate runtime errors. This initiative improved maintainability and reduced bug reports by 25% within six months. Another project involved implementing Web performance optimization techniques across security monitoring tools, which included minifying assets, leveraging browser caching, and prioritizing critical rendering paths. The result was a 40% improvement in first-contentful-paint metrics, enhancing user experience during high-stress incident response scenarios. A third project focused on accessibility, where I developed a reusable component library for security analysts, ensuring compliance with WCAG 2.1 while maintaining the platform’s security integrity. These projects underscored the importance of balancing usability with security, a recurring theme in my work.  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Moscow State University, 2021. Graduated with a focus on software engineering and distributed systems, which provided a strong theoretical foundation for tackling frontend challenges in cybersecurity contexts.  

Technical Skills  
React: Core to all frontend development, with ownership of critical components in security monitoring platforms. TypeScript: Used extensively to enforce type safety in complex state management systems. Web performance optimization: Implemented strategies to enhance load times and user interaction in high-stakes environments. Responsive design: Integral to dashboard development, ensuring adaptability across devices without compromising security workflows. Security testing: Conducted regular audits to identify vulnerabilities in UI components, aligning with the company’s zero-trust architecture. REST API design: Integrated with backend services to facilitate real-time data updates. Test automation: Utilized for regression testing of UI changes, ensuring stability across browser environments.  

Certifications  
Google Professional Cloud Developer (2022) — validated cloud-based development practices for scalable applications.  

Languages  
Russian (native), English (professional working proficiency), Hebrew (basic conversational).
